brief.make: Black sphere; grab, carry, release in place.
brief.given: Museum; configured XR hand; XRToolsPickable; collision settings; black material settings.
brief.build: Body; matching mesh/shape; direct refs; frozen release.
brief.check: Hold moves both; release stays; disabled refuses; new radius matches.
brief.later: Grip pose; trigger action; labels; coordinate readouts.

host: Empty unit-scale Node3D station in a working copy of the lit Endless Museum with its configured XR Tools hand. Native proof uses a private test world, not a museum placement.

checks.expect: A pickable body owns matching sphere mesh and collision shape.

checks.action: Bring the real library detector near; then disable the point.
checks.expect: Overlap allows selection; disabled point refuses it.

checks.action: Pick up, move synthetic controller, drop and move controller again.
checks.expect: Body follows while held; release restores configured layers and stays frozen.

checks.action: Run code with a different RADIUS.
checks.expect: Visible mesh and physical shape have the new matching radius.

checks.action: Rebuild from brief; record help used.
checks.expect: Learner can assemble required parts and name supplied support.

checks.action: Predict changing radius versus disabling pickup.
checks.expect: Explain shared dimensions separately from interaction eligibility.

checks.action: Place the exercise station beside the encounter in a working museum copy.
checks.expect: Reachable and visible; no accidental dependence on the original point or wall readouts.

checks.action: Use physical hand/controller to grab, move and release.
checks.expect: The selected behaviour works with the prepared player and is comfortable to perform.
